2608.24358.title: The Handoff Tax: Continuing Non-Native Trajectories in LLM Agents
2608.24358.paper_summary: Coding agents perform long-running tasks spanning dozens of model calls, tool uses, and code edits. As these runs unfold, users face a practical cost-quality trade-off: escalating to a stronger model when a cheaper one struggles, or downshifting once the hard reasoning is complete. Each switch requires the receiver to continue a non-native trajectory produced by another model. We study how this handoff affects quality and cost, and how varying the trajectory information inherited by the receiver changes the outcome. Using pairs of low-cost, low-capability (LC) and high-cost, high-capability (HC) models from the Claude and GPT families, we vary handoff direction, timing, and interface, comparing full-trajectory transfer, compaction, and trajectory removal while preserving the repository state. Across both model families, full-trajectory escalation recovers less than half of the LC-to-HC quality gap while incurring a substantial cost premium. We term this cost-quality penalty the handoff tax. By contrast, downshift offers a favorable cost-quality point. Interestingly, the preferred interface also reverses with direction: reducing LC-model trajectory information improves escalation quality, whereas removing the HC-model trajectory reduces downshift quality.
2608.24358.paper_summary_zh: 編碼代理執行長時間的任務，涵蓋數十次模型調用、工具使用和代碼編輯。隨著這些運行的展開，使用者面臨實際的成本與品質權衡：在較便宜的模型表現不佳時升級到更強的模型，或在艱難推理完成後降級。每次切換都要求接收者繼續由另一個模型產生的非本地軌跡。我們研究這種交接如何影響品質和成本，以及接收者繼承的軌跡信息的變化如何改變結果。使用來自Claude和GPT系列的低成本、低能力（LC）模型和高成本、高能力（HC）模型的配對，我們變化交接的方向、時機和介面，並比較全軌跡轉移、壓縮和軌跡移除，同時保持存儲庫狀態。在這兩個模型系列中，全軌跡升級回收的LC到HC的品質差距不到一半，同時產生了可觀的成本溢價。我們將這種成本品質懲罰稱為交接稅。相比之下，降級提供了一個有利的成本品質點。有趣的是，首選介面也隨著方向而反轉：減少LC模型的軌跡信息改善了升級品質，而移除HC模型的軌跡則降低了降級品質。
